faults.title: Bluetooth connection problems (F30)
faults.description: On the 2012-2018 F30, phones may struggle to connect over Bluetooth. Auto Express says a software update may be needed, which an approved BMW dealer can do.

faults.title: Squeaky front seat frames (F30)
faults.description: Corrosion can make the hinges and adjustment mechanism in the front seat frames squeak.

faults.title: Diesel EGR cooler fire-risk recall (F30)
faults.description: Recalls in June 2018 and October 2019 hit diesel F30s with a faulty exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) cooler, which could cause a fire risk from burning soot deposits.

faults.title: Power steering electrics and fuel starvation recalls (F30)
faults.description: Other F30 recalls covered electrical faults that could affect the electric power steering (October 2016), stalling from fuel starvation (2015) and possible clutch failure on manuals (2013).
